description.narrative: The project involves: the improvement and further development of the JCL underground gold mine; the exploration of an adjacent area; and early stage development of other projects in China. JCL started its operation in 1998 and currently produces about 100,000 oz of gold annually. Developmental Impact The project is expected to positively impact economic growth and poverty alleviation in three ways: - Demonstrating the viability and attractiveness of investing in Chinas mining sector: To date, SML is the only foreign owned ore mining company operated in China. The project will enhance SMLs success, setting an example for foreign investors considering activities in China, in particular junior mining companies. - Demonstrating the viability and success of improving environmental and social best practices in mining in China: With IFC''s assistance, SML will further improve its practices and compliance standards, and stimulate other companies to learn from its example. - Helping reform China''s gold mining sector: The project will support Chinese government''s efforts to enhance the gold mining sector''s competitiveness by introducing western management practices and by transferring technology to China. IFCs Role By helping SML to achieve its growth objectives in western China, IFC would play a catalytic role demonstrating that foreign investment in the mining sector in the west of China is viable. In working with SML, IFC would also be able to help extend the frontiers of environmental and social responsibility for junior mining companies, setting examples for future mining projects in China.

name.narrative: The JCL gold mining operation is located in Hejiayan town, Lueyang County, approximately 30 km east of the Lueyang town and 50 km west of Mianxian in Shaanxi Province. Access is typically by an overnight train from Xian to Mianxian, followed by a one and a half to two hours drive, mostly along Highway 301, an all weather road connecting Lueyang and Mianxian. The project site is situated at an elevation between 780 and 990 meters above sea level.
